themeSelectors..model .setting-item-description: typo in theme.css (.model instead of .modal); matches nothing in Obsidian
themeSelectors..suggestion-item.mobile-tap: mobile-tap is only set by the mobile app on touch
themeSelectors..metadata-container .metadata-show-sourc: the Show source button is text-only in Obsidian 1.15.1 (app.js builds it with just a .text-button-label span; see fixture extra.properties-show-source.hover), so it has no .svg-icon
themeSelectors..bases-toolbar-menu-item.selected: Obsidian sets .selected only on .menu-item rows during Menu keyboard navigation (app.js Menu.select); Bases toolbar menu rows use .is-selected instead
themeSelectors.body:not(.is-phone) .horizontal-tab-nav-: no horizontal tab nav exists in Obsidian 1.15.1: .horizontal-tab-nav-item never appeared in the runtime class census and no string in the shipped code can build it

appClassPatterns.^mobile-: mobile app UI (navbar, toolbar, tab switcher, vault chooser, onboarding); desktop never builds it
appClassPatterns.^workspace-drawer: mobile sidebar drawer; desktop uses split sidebars instead
appClassPatterns.^(has-swipe|is-swiping|is-sliding|has-lo: mobile-only state (touch gestures, mobile toolbar or navigation)
appClassPatterns.^(sync|publish|site)-: Obsidian Sync / Publish screens that need a signed-in account with a subscription; the capture runs signed out
appClassPatterns.^mod-avatar-: collaborator avatars in Sync history; needs a signed-in shared vault

platformSelectors..mod-windows .titlebar-button.mod-close:: on Linux the window buttons hold a plain inline <svg> without .svg-icon (see fixture chrome.titlebar-button.hover); Windows builds its own buttons, which swapping the body class cannot reproduce
platformSelectors..mod-macos.is-hidden-frameless:not(.is-p: on Linux Obsidian puts .sidebar-toggle-button.mod-secondary outside .mod-sidedock; the macOS placement is built by app.js on macOS only, which swapping the body class cannot reproduce
platformSelectors..is-hidden-frameless:not(.starter,.is-po: Windows draws back/forward buttons in its titlebar; the Linux window has no .titlebar-button.mod-back/.mod-forward (see fixture chrome.titlebar), and swapping the body class cannot add them
